## Endpoints

### Data Read (2)
- `GET /locales/en/{id}.json` — Retrieve a specific locale file.
- `GET /manifest.webmanifest` — Retrieve the web application manifest.

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /v1/projects/tasksboard-main/installations` — Install tasksboard project for an agent.

### Media (1)
- `POST /getcaptcha/{getcaptchaId}` — Retrieve a CAPTCHA image.

### Config (2)
- `GET /{id}/projects/-/apps/1:938219596206:web:d148e136fcb08f873e803f/webconfig` — Get web configuration for a specific app.
- `POST /checksiteconfig` — Check the site configuration.

### Core API (1)
- `POST /agent/{agentId}/chat/init` — Initialize a chat session for an agent.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Tasksboard's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Tasksboard data without official API access
- Automate actions on tasksboard.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Tasksboard frontend uses
